items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The person to judge is the interviewee himself (Danny Barker / Daniel Moses Barco, Jr.).

ctx.x: Okay, sit down the way you want to sit Danny. Okay. This is being recorded at the home of Danny Barco, 495 West 130th Street. In the slums of New York. Oh God. And the date is June the 30th, 1959. Okay Danny, say your name. We'll put it right here in between us. We'll pick us both up. Say your name so we'll know what your life sounds like.
My name is Daniel Moses Barco, Jr. New Orleans.
